sources.title: Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is fed with this masked token sequence, and trained to produce the original sequence. For example, given the input sequence "*Que para sobre o PTT5!*", the model is trained to produce the sequence "*Que belo dia para aprendermos sobre o maravilhoso PTT5!*", where "" is a mask token. Note that this is an illustrative example.

sources.title: PTT5: T5 for Brazilian Portuguese
sources.snippet: This paper presents PTT5, an adaptation of the T5 model tailored specifically for Brazilian Portuguese by leveraging the BrWac corpus. The paper demonstrates that pretrained LLMs exhibit performance enhancements on tasks in their respective languages when trained on monolingual data rather than relying exclusively on multilingual datasets.
